_readme: n8n Data Table seed rows required at test time. NO real secrets — the token is a placeholder (MOCK-TOKEN-COUPA). All rows written via n8n_manage_datatable at test phase only; purge at teardown. NOTE: writes require owner permission (currently READ-ONLY per OQ-003).

existingRowLeaveInPlace._note: The standing row (real expired JWT from the Coupa TEST instance). Do NOT modify; Step1/2/3 + Token Regen filter on client='coastal_waste' so this row is never matched.

seedRow._why: Step 1/2/3 read the Bearer token from here (filter client='coastal_waste'); Token Regen reads 'scope' from here and upserts 'oauth_token' back. Analogue of OQ-028's dummy token row id 2. Without it, Step1/2/3 'Get Coupa Token' returns 0 items and the run halts (matches source continueWhenNoRes:false).

seedRowsForExportTest.errorMsg: Location's Site Manager for Task# 9001 was not found in Coupa.
Selected Account (CWR-099-999-612200-Other Operating) does not exist in Coupa.

raceProofRow.errorMsg: Inserted BETWEEN the export's read and delete to prove OQ-006 partial-delete (this row must SURVIVE the run).
raceProofRow._op: insert AFTER triggering the export, during the Ionos send window

errorLogTable._note: Step 1 (error paths A-E) and Step 3 (attach/comment failures) also WRITE rows here at runtime during their error scenarios. Those are runtime writes, not seeds.

mockConfigTable._op: createTable (new; OQ-028's bZ78rLHH8sJfDbtN was deleted at teardown)

mockCaptureTable._op: createTable (new; OQ-028's u7iAudMydWyhl7BJ was deleted at teardown)
mockCaptureTable.seedRows: none — populated by the mock at runtime, one row per inbound Coupa call, for diffing payloads against the build specs.
